items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries: OUT/DOUBTFUL include Brock Bowers, Nico Collins, Zay Flowers/Ja'Kobi Lane, Kyler Murray/Jauan Jennings, AJ Brown, Sam Darnold, Michael Penix/Tua, etc. Q: Ladd McConkey, Chris Olave, Joe Burrow (said playing), Michael Pittman, RJ Harvey, Kaelon Black. IN: TreVeyon Henderson, Alec Pierce, Jalen Coker, Alvin Kamara, Sean Tucker.
items.implication: Status changes drive beneficiaries; pace notes NO@BAL up, LV@LAC slow.

items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable vs Raiders due to rib injury; practiced Friday.
items.why: Rib injury; practiced but Q designation.
items.implication: Biggest Q on slate per Levitan; impacts Herbert and QJ/Harris volume if limited/out. Game at 4pm ET.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Week 2 vs Bengals.
items.why: Missed practice with hamstring; official Friday ruling.
items.implication: HOU WR room to crumbs; boosts Dalton Schultz and remaining WRs for volume.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints with hamstring.
items.why: Missed practices with hamstring after exiting Week 1.
items.implication: Plan without him; Mark Andrews TE1 lock, Bateman hierarchy rises.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful vs Chargers due to knee, per HC.
items.why: Knee injury; HC Klint Kubiak confirmation.
items.implication: Avoid; Michael Mayer or other TEs get look if out.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is biggest injury on the slate, affects so many other projections including Justin Herbert. Game starts at 4pm ET. BAL/HOU/NE down to crumbs at WR.
items.why: Ribs Q; high leverage on Herbert and Chargers pass catchers.
items.implication: Monitor closely; QJ/Harris volume spike if out/limited.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers right now with AJ Brown IR; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in his 2026 debut? Returning at right time vs nice matchups stretch. Still unclear vs Rhamondre Stevenson.
items.why: Ready to go comments; team need for explosives; schedule.
items.implication: 10+ touch potential; monitor split with Stevenson.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back; he said he would play and coach expects him.
items.why: Back soreness; self and coach comments positive.
items.implication: Expected to start; ride him in most formats.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: handled 21 of 24 team RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), targeted 40% routes tying team lead. Indy gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization + juicy matchup vs poor run D.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite utilization and consistent high-touch role.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 utilization Week 1, 26% target share, every RB red-zone touch. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC; out-routed Gainwell.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes passing role; NO underdogs bad script.
items.why: Kamara return squeezes; negative game script.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Kamara IN reverses prior Etienne bump.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter.
items.why: Week 1 usage strong; Black Q impacts handcuff/backup role.
items.implication: CMC volume safe/bumped; Black relevant if CMC limited later.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; avg 93 rec yds/18 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. Bears D soft per Carolina WRs.
